Rosa Lam: Hey team! I'm Rosa — excited to join the Platform squad. I like succulents, chamomile tea, and weekend tinkering in my tiny balcony garden. Desk swap?

Sam: Welcome Rosa!! Where are you based?

Rosa Lam: SF, usually in the 3rd floor area, desk near the east windows. I brought a little jade plant, looking for a spot with natural light.

Aviya Sato: Welcome!!! I have a succulent that doubles as a paperweight, happy to trade cuttings 🌱

Juniper: hi rosa :wave: we have a low-light plant shelf near the pantry, sometimes people rotate props. also, there's a welcome coffee tomorrow at 10 if you want to swing by ☕️

Onboarding Bot: Tip: complete your badge pick-up at 2pm today at reception.

Rosa Lam: Thanks @Aviya, @Juniper — I can bring some chamomile cookies too. Also does anyone know where extra terra cotta pots live?

Sam: There's a box in the amenities closet labeled 'plants + party supplies' lol.

Aviya Sato: I'll bring a tiny pot tomorrow. Also curious — team lunch on Friday?

Juniper: I'm in. 🌮 poll: :taco: or :bento:? react to vote.

Rosa Lam: :taco: for me

Sam: :bento: (but happy with tacos)

Aviya Sato: :taco:

Juniper: Awesome. Also FYI our team slack thread for desk requests is #eng-sre-desk-ops. I'll ping facilities.

Rosa Lam: Thanks all — excited to meet folks in person. Also, please share meme recommendations for onboarding playlists 😅

Sam: Welcome again! :partyparrot:
